runSummary.goal: Find a change that gets every home its water on time. Keep the same workers and resources. Only one edit per trial.
runSummary.summary:
Systematic simulator search of allowed single edits: `search_one_edit scope=all` — 22 trials checked, `searchComplete=true`, no trial with `goalMet=true`.

Best measured single edit, improved, but not solved:

* Move `bridge-south` to row 5
* Result: 24/24 delivered, 22/24 on time vs baseline 16/24 on time
* `lateUnits`: 8 -> 2
* `waitTicks`: 34 -> 20, `completedAt`: 117 -> 98
* Remaining miss: Hilltop `h6` misses deadline 94 by 2 unit(s), first delivery 89 but final units late; `deadline_missed tick 94`
* Fixes Cedar `h4` and Willow `h5` vs baseline

Tradeoff: during north closure 25-50 all east-side traffic concentrates on the moved south bridge — `bridgeQueues: bridge-south 8`. That central position shortens east-side routes and reduces total waiting, but leaves no spare crossing capacity if Hilltop batches queue behind Willow/Cedar; Hilltop tail remains late.

Recommendation: if limited to one edit, use bridge-south row 5 for largest reduction, but do not treat as verified on-time solution — tool reports `goalMet=false`.
